commits.subject: Separate auth from owner-key unlock: friends fully usable pre-unlock except genuinely owner-key operations

Admin panel: friend list never rendered on page load - the ask-modal markup sat AFTER the script, so a top-level getElementById('ask-cancel') hit null, threw, and killed the script before load() ran (list only appeared after adding a friend, whose handler calls load() directly). Moved the modal markup before the script; proven with a DOM harness: old file throws TypeError, new file renders all friends + sessions on load

Restart-proof friend list + truthful 2FA status: access list mirrored to access.enc under a server-held restore key (env NEXUS_RESTORE_KEY) and rebuilt at boot; friend logins decoupled from key unlock (chat/transcribe return a clear locked message until admin login); admin panel reads 2FA state from the session on load

Audit quick wins: /api/usage never sent HTTP headers (raw JSON to socket -> 502) - fixed, plus per-line parse guards in usage/quotas handlers, legacy friend-hash upgrade on login, JSON 401 for /api/models, 400 on invalid routing mode
